name: gutlog
description: Gutlog by Meter: the food and gut database your AI assistant writes to. Log meals from a photo or a sentence with calories, macros, nutrients and ingredients (each with a confidence you can fix), scan barcodes, read your day, and check plans, from the conversation, the CLI or CI.

api_key.title: Gutlog API key (optional)
api_key.description: Leave empty to sign in with your browser (/mcp). Or paste a gutlog_… key from https://getgutlog.com/dashboard/settings?ref=plugin for a machine without a browser: Claude Code keeps it in your system's secure credential store and sends it only to the Gutlog MCP server, in the X-Api-Key header.
